notes.title: 'Slay the Dragon!' is nominated for The Rookies Award!
notes.notes:
The team would like to announce another exciting news: 'Slay the Dragon!' is nominated for The Rookies Awards! As of this moment, we are in the category of 'Console & PC'. But that is not all! You can also go in and vote for 'Slay the Dragon!' as your People's Choice, which is another category. So if you enjoyed 'Slay the dragon!*, kindly follow the link, and click the 'CAST YOUR PEOPLE'S CHOICE VOTE' in the upper right corner. It will create a post on Facebook, which is how they will count the votes at the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39513369/80868fa264f8baa0588e4fa98d0a14fb5f4f7888.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 'Slay the Dragon!' is nominated for a Student BAFTA Award!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our 3rd year project, the game 'Slay the Dragon!', is one of the finalist for the Student BAFTA Awards 2021! As if that wasn't enough, almost 6,500 of you have played the game. All of this has been beyond our wildest dreams, and we are eternally grateful. 

You can view the Student BAFTA Awards list here:  [url=store.steampowered.com] https://www.bafta.org/los-angeles/events-initiatives/news/finalists-announced-for-2021-gsa-bafta-student-awards [/url]

The Award Ceremony will take place on Friday 23rd July. We hope you will join us, and cross your fingers for us.

Until then, stay safe, and have a wonderful summer.
